# Plot-Level Inventory-SDA Validations (not including maps or pred vs obs plots)
## 1. Data Preparation 

##### 1a. Filter FIA TREE table data by selected plots
```{r Filter FIA TREE table data by selected plots, echo=FALSE}

# Upload FIA data and connect to database
FIA_Data <- dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  "/projectnb/dietzelab/fia/SQLite_FIADB_ENTIRE.db"
)

# Load list of selected plot CNs (these CNs correspond exactly to SDA sites created by Dongchen Zhang)
Selected_Plots <- read.table(
  "/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/inventory_validation/selected_fia_cn.txt",
  header = FALSE
)

# Make plot CNs character, make string for query
Selected_Plots[[1]] <- as.character(Selected_Plots[[1]])
selplotcn <- Selected_Plots[[1]]
selplotcnstring <- paste(selplotcn, collapse = ", ")

# Query PLOT table for selected plots and their previous plot CNs if applicable
filter_query_plot <- paste(
  "SELECT * FROM PLOT WHERE CN IN (", selplotcnstring,
  ") OR PREV_PLT_CN IN (", selplotcnstring, ");"
)

# Pull filtered PLOT table
FilteredPLOT <- dbGetQuery(FIA_Data, filter_query_plot)

# Find plots whose PREV_PLT_CN matches selected plots
selprevPLOTquery <- paste(
  "SELECT CN FROM PLOT WHERE PREV_PLT_CN IN (", selplotcnstring, ");")
selprevPLOTCN <- dbGetQuery(FIA_Data, selprevPLOTquery)

# CN string for previous plots
selprevCNstring <- paste(selprevPLOTCN$CN, collapse = ", ")

# Pull TREE records for previous plots
selprevTREECNquery <- paste(
  "SELECT * FROM TREE WHERE PLT_CN IN (", selprevCNstring, ");")
selprevTREE <- dbGetQuery(FIA_Data, selprevTREECNquery)

# Pull TREE records for selected plots
selTREEquery <- paste(
  "SELECT * FROM TREE WHERE PLT_CN IN (", selplotcnstring, ");")
selTREE <- dbGetQuery(FIA_Data, selTREEquery)

# Combine TREE data from current and previous plots
FilteredTREE <- bind_rows(selTREE, selprevTREE)
```

##### 1b. Calculate observed FC, WC, TC
```{r Calculate observed carbon, echo=FALSE}
## Add C values to PLOT table ##

# Get rid of dead trees (filter out rows where AGENTCD and/or MORTYR has a value
FilteredTREE <- FilteredTREE %>%
  filter(is.na(AGENTCD))

FilteredTREE <- FilteredTREE %>%
  filter(is.na(MORTYR))

# Convert to metric units
# Conversion factor from pounds/acre to kg/m^2
conversion_factor_lbacre <- 0.45359237 / 4046.85642

# Calculate C per unit area for wood and foliage
summarizeTREE <- FilteredTREE %>%
  group_by(PLT_CN) %>%
  summarize(
    WC_Obs = sum(
      CARBON_AG * TPA_UNADJ * conversion_factor_lbacre,
      na.rm = TRUE), # Observed woody carbon (kg/m2)
    
    WC_SD_Obs = sd(
      CARBON_AG * TPA_UNADJ * conversion_factor_lbacre,
      na.rm = TRUE),
    
    FC_Obs = sum(
      DRYBIO_FOLIAGE * 0.5 * TPA_UNADJ * conversion_factor_lbacre,
      na.rm = TRUE), # Observed foliage carbon (kg/m2)
    
    FC_SD_Obs = sd(
      DRYBIO_FOLIAGE * 0.5 * TPA_UNADJ * conversion_factor_lbacre,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

# Calculate total C per unit area for each plot
FilteredTREE <- summarizeTREE %>%
  mutate(Tot_C_Obs = WC_Obs + FC_Obs)

# Join modified TREE and PLOT tables matching PLT_CN from TREE with CN from PLOT
FilteredPLOT <- FilteredPLOT %>%
  left_join(FilteredTREE, by = c("CN" = "PLT_CN"))

# Keep only relevant columns
FilteredPLOT <- FilteredPLOT %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CN,
    PREV_PLT_CN,
    INVYR,
    LAT,
    LON,
    ELEV,
    WC_Obs,
    FC_Obs,
    Tot_C_Obs
  )
```
```{r Load SIPNET, echo=FALSE}
## Edit SDA data to have Site Number in column names ##

# Load data
load("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/sda.all.forecast.analysis.Rdata")
load("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/site_info.Rdata")

# Rename SIPNET lists to their corresponding year
names(analysis.all) <- 2012:2024
year <- 2012:2024

# Define variable names
variables <- c("AbvGrndWood", "LAI", "SoilMoistFrac", "TotSoilCarb")

# Loop over years
for (year in names(analysis.all)) { 
  year_df <- analysis.all[[year]]
  new_colnames <- character(ncol(year_df))
  for (site in 1:8000) { # loop over sites
    start_col <- (site - 1) * 4 + 1 # starting column for site
    new_colnames[start_col:(start_col + 3)] <- paste0(variables, "_Site", site)
  }
  colnames(year_df) <- new_colnames
  analysis.all[[year]] <- year_df
}

```

##### 1c. Assign the closest site number to each plot
```{r Assign the closest site number, echo=FALSE}
## Add column with closest site number for each plot in FilteredPLOT ##

# Pull site PFT 
site_pft <- read.csv("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/site_pft.csv")
site_info <- as.data.frame(site_info)

# Keep PFTs used in SDA
allowed_sites <- site_pft %>%
  filter(pft %in% c("boreal.coniferous", "temperate.deciduous.HPDA"))

# Site IDs to character
site_info$site_ids <- as.character(site_info$site_ids)
allowed_sites$site <- as.character(allowed_sites$site)

# Filter site_info to con/decid sites
site_info_allowed <- site_info %>%
  filter(site_ids %in% allowed_sites$site)

# Site coordinates
Site_Coordinates <- as.matrix(site_info_allowed[, c("lat", "lon")])
mode(Site_Coordinates) <- "numeric"

# Plot coordinates
FilteredPLOT_Coordinates <- as.matrix(FilteredPLOT[, c("LAT", "LON")])
mode(FilteredPLOT_Coordinates) <- "numeric"

# Make closest-site column
FilteredPLOT$Closest_Site <- NA
max_dist_km <- 20 # distance cutoff

for (i in 1:nrow(FilteredPLOT)) { # loop over plots
  plot_coords <- FilteredPLOT_Coordinates[i, ]
  distances <- spDistsN1(Site_Coordinates, plot_coords, longlat = TRUE)
  min_idx <- which.min(distances)
  if (distances[min_idx] <= max_dist_km) FilteredPLOT$Closest_Site[i] <- site_info_allowed$site_ids[min_idx]
}

# Keep needed columns
FilteredPLOT <- FilteredPLOT %>%
  dplyr::select(CN, PREV_PLT_CN, INVYR, LAT, LON, ELEV, WC_Obs, FC_Obs, Tot_C_Obs, Closest_Site)

```

##### 1d. Filter SIPNET data with relevant site/year combinations
```{r Filter SIPNET data with relevant site/year combinations, echo=FALSE}
## Filter analysis.all to only include relevant sites ##

# Pull sites used by FIA plots
sites_to_keep <- FilteredPLOT$Closest_Site

# Filter SIPNET outputs to chosen FIA matched sites
analysis.fia <- list()
for (year in names(analysis.all)) { # loop over years
  df <- analysis.all[[year]]
  pattern <- paste0("_Site(", paste(sites_to_keep, collapse = "|"), ")$")
  analysis.fia[[year]] <- df[, grep(pattern, colnames(df))]
}

## Keep only valid site-year combinations ##
valid_combinations <- unique(FilteredPLOT[, c("INVYR", "Closest_Site")])

# Filter again by inventory year
for (year in names(analysis.fia)) { # loop over years
  year_df <- analysis.fia[[year]]
  current_year <- as.numeric(substr(year, 1, 4))
  valid_sites <- valid_combinations$Closest_Site[valid_combinations$INVYR == current_year]
  matching_columns <- grep(paste0("_Site(", paste(valid_sites, collapse = "|"), ")$"),
                           colnames(year_df), value = TRUE)
  analysis.fia[[year]] <- year_df[, matching_columns, drop = FALSE]
}
```


##### 1f. Calculate modeled FC, WC, and TC
```{r Calculate modeled carbon pools, echo=FALSE}
## Create final model data table ##

# List to store yearly summaries
summary_list <- list()

# Match names to full SDA list
names(analysis.fia) <- names(analysis.all)

# Loop over years
for (year in names(analysis.all)) {
  year_only <- year
  df <- analysis.fia[[year]]
  site_numbers <- unique(gsub(".*_Site(\\d+)", "\\1", colnames(df))) # pull site numbers from column names

  # Empty summary table for this year
  summary_table <- data.frame(Site_Number = numeric(0),
                              Year = character(0),
                              FC_Mean_Mod = numeric(0),
                              FC_SD_Mod = numeric(0),
                              WC_Mean_Mod = numeric(0),
                              WC_SD_Mod = numeric(0),
                              Tot_C_Mean_Mod = numeric(0),
                              Tot_C_SD_Mod = numeric(0),
                              stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # Loop over sites
  for (site in site_numbers) {
    lai_col <- paste0("LAI_Site", site)
    abv_col <- paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site", site)

    if (lai_col %in% colnames(df) && abv_col %in% colnames(df)) {
      pft_site <- sitepft$pft[match(as.numeric(site), sitepft$site)]
      if (is.na(pft_site) || !(pft_site %in% names(filtered_samples))) next
      sla_vec <- filtered_samples[[pft_site]]$SLA

      leafC <- 0.5 * df[[lai_col]] / sla_vec # transform FC, WC, TC
      woodC <- 0.1 * df[[abv_col]]
      AGC <- woodC + leafC

      summary_table <- rbind(summary_table,
        data.frame(Site_Number = as.numeric(site),
                   Year = year_only,
                   FC_Mean_Mod = mean(leafC, na.rm = TRUE),
                   FC_SD_Mod = sd(leafC, na.rm = TRUE),
                   WC_Mean_Mod = mean(woodC, na.rm = TRUE),
                   WC_SD_Mod = sd(woodC, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Tot_C_Mean_Mod = mean(AGC, na.rm = TRUE),
                   Tot_C_SD_Mod = sd(AGC, na.rm = TRUE)))
    }
  }

  summary_list[[year]] <- summary_table
}

# Combine all years
final_summary_table <- do.call(rbind, summary_list)
```

##### 1i. Calculate summary statistics

Note: "Overall" = across both **PFT**s

```{r Calculate plot-level summary statistics, echo=FALSE}

## Create overall summary statistic table ##

# Calculate Residuals
FIA_Model_Combined$FCResidual <- FIA_Model_Combined$FC_Obs - FIA_Model_Combined$FC_Mean_Mod
FIA_Model_Combined$WCResidual <- FIA_Model_Combined$WC_Obs - FIA_Model_Combined$WC_Mean_Mod
FIA_Model_Combined$TCResidual <- FIA_Model_Combined$Tot_C_Obs - FIA_Model_Combined$Tot_C_Mean_Mod

# Calculate metrics
TC_bias <- mean(FIA_Model_Combined$TCResidual, na.rm = TRUE)
FC_bias <- mean(FIA_Model_Combined$FCResidual, na.rm = TRUE)
WC_bias <- mean(FIA_Model_Combined$WCResidual, na.rm = TRUE)

TC_MAE <- mean(abs(FIA_Model_Combined$TCResidual), na.rm = TRUE)
FC_MAE <- mean(abs(FIA_Model_Combined$FCResidual), na.rm = TRUE)
WC_MAE <- mean(abs(FIA_Model_Combined$WCResidual), na.rm = TRUE)

TC_RMSE <- sqrt(mean(FIA_Model_Combined$TCResidual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
FC_RMSE <- sqrt(mean(FIA_Model_Combined$FCResidual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
WC_RMSE <- sqrt(mean(FIA_Model_Combined$WCResidual^2, na.rm = TRUE))

# Create the Summary_Stats_Overall table
Summary_Stats_Overall <- data.frame(
  TC_bias = TC_bias,
  FC_bias = FC_bias,
  WC_bias = WC_bias,
  TC_MAE = TC_MAE,
  FC_MAE = FC_MAE,
  WC_MAE = WC_MAE,
  TC_RMSE = TC_RMSE,
  FC_RMSE = FC_RMSE,
  WC_RMSE = WC_RMSE
)
```

```{r Plot-level CRPS calculation, echo=FALSE}
## CRPS Calulation (package = scoringRules)

# Empty df for CRPS results
CRPS_Values <- data.frame(Site = integer(),
                          Year = integer(),
                          FC_CRPS = numeric(),
                          WC_CRPS = numeric(),
                          FC_Con_CRPS = numeric(),
                          WC_Con_CRPS = numeric(),
                          FC_Decid_CRPS = numeric(),
                          WC_Decid_CRPS = numeric(),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop years
for (year in unique(FIA_Model_Combined$INVYR)) {
  model_data <- analysis.fia[[as.character(year)]]
  obs_data <- subset(FIA_Model_Combined, INVYR == year)

  # Loop sites in each year
  for (site in unique(obs_data$Closest_Site)) {
    fc_obs <- obs_data$FC_Obs[obs_data$Closest_Site == site]
    wc_obs <- obs_data$WC_Obs[obs_data$Closest_Site == site]
    pft <- obs_data$pft[obs_data$Closest_Site == site]

    lai_col <- paste0("LAI_Site", site)
    abv_col <- paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site", site)
    if (!(lai_col %in% names(model_data)) || !(abv_col %in% names(model_data))) next

    lai_ens <- model_data[[lai_col]]
    abv_ens <- model_data[[abv_col]]

    pft_site <- sitepft$pft[match(as.numeric(site), sitepft$site)]
    if (is.na(pft_site) || !(pft_site %in% names(filtered_samples))) next
    sla_vec <- filtered_samples[[pft_site]]$SLA
    if (length(sla_vec) != length(lai_ens)) stop("SLA length != ensemble length for site ", site)

    foliage_ens <- 0.5 * lai_ens / sla_vec
    wood_ens <- 0.1 * abv_ens

    fc_crps <- if (length(foliage_ens) > 0) crps_sample(fc_obs, foliage_ens) else NA
    wc_crps <- if (length(wood_ens) > 0) crps_sample(wc_obs, wood_ens) else NA

    fc_con_crps <- if (pft == "boreal.coniferous") fc_crps else NA
    wc_con_crps <- if (pft == "boreal.coniferous") wc_crps else NA
    fc_decid_crps <- if (pft == "temperate.deciduous.HPDA") fc_crps else NA
    wc_decid_crps <- if (pft == "temperate.deciduous.HPDA") wc_crps else NA

    CRPS_Values <- rbind(CRPS_Values, data.frame(Site = site,
                    Year = year,
                    FC_CRPS = fc_crps,
                    WC_CRPS = wc_crps,
                    FC_Con_CRPS = fc_con_crps,
                    WC_Con_CRPS = wc_con_crps,
                    FC_Decid_CRPS = fc_decid_crps,
                    WC_Decid_CRPS = wc_decid_crps))
  }
}

# Add CRPS to summary tables
Summary_Stats_Coniferous$FC_CRPS <- mean(CRPS_Values$FC_Con_CRPS, na.rm = TRUE)
Summary_Stats_Coniferous$WC_CRPS <- mean(CRPS_Values$WC_Con_CRPS, na.rm = TRUE)
Summary_Stats_Deciduous$FC_CRPS <- mean(CRPS_Values$FC_Decid_CRPS, na.rm = TRUE)
Summary_Stats_Deciduous$WC_CRPS <- mean(CRPS_Values$WC_Decid_CRPS, na.rm = TRUE)
Summary_Stats_Overall$FC_CRPS <- mean(CRPS_Values$FC_CRPS, na.rm = TRUE)
Summary_Stats_Overall$WC_CRPS <- mean(CRPS_Values$WC_CRPS, na.rm = TRUE)

knitr::kable(Summary_Stats_Overall, caption = "Overall Summary Statistics")
knitr::kable(Summary_Stats_Coniferous, caption = "Coniferous Summary Statistics")
knitr::kable(Summary_Stats_Deciduous, caption = "Deciduous Summary Statistics")
```

##### 1j. Calculate FIA annual growth
```{r Calculate plot-level FIA annual growth, echo=FALSE}
# Calculate annual growth rates for observed and modeled variables
growth_table <- FIA_Model_Combined %>%
  arrange(Closest_Site, INVYR) %>% # sort by site and year
  group_by(Closest_Site) %>% # do growth diffs within each site
  mutate(year_diff = INVYR - lag(INVYR), # years between inventories
         obs_wc = (WC_Obs - lag(WC_Obs)) / year_diff, # observed WC growth
         obs_fc = (FC_Obs - lag(FC_Obs)) / year_diff, # observed FC growth
         obs_tc = (Tot_C_Obs - lag(Tot_C_Obs)) / year_diff, # observed TC growth
         year = paste0(lag(INVYR), "-", INVYR)) %>% # year span label
  filter(!is.na(obs_wc) & !is.na(obs_fc) & !is.na(obs_tc)) %>% # drop first inventory per site
  dplyr::select(site_number = Closest_Site,
                CN,
                year,
                lat = LAT,
                lon = LON,
                pft = pft,
                obs_fc,
                obs_wc,
                obs_tc)
```

##### 1k. Calculate SDA annual growth
```{r Calculate plot-level SDA annual growth, echo=FALSE}
# Create empty list for transformed data
analysis.transformed <- vector("list", length(analysis.all))
names(analysis.transformed) <- names(analysis.all) # keep year names

# Loop through each year in analysis.all
for (i in seq_along(analysis.all)) {
  year_data <- analysis.all[[i]]
  transformed_data <- list()
  # Loop through each site
  for (site in 1:8000) {
    wood_var <- paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site", site) # wood var name
    lai_var <- paste0("LAI_Site", site) # LAI var name
    pft_site <- sitepft$pft[match(as.numeric(site), sitepft$site)] # site PFT
    if (is.na(pft_site) || !(pft_site %in% names(filtered_samples))) next # skip if no SLA
    sla_vec <- filtered_samples[[pft_site]]$SLA # SLA by ensemble member
    if (!(lai_var %in% names(year_data))) next # skip if missing LAI
    lai_ens <- year_data[[lai_var]] # LAI ensemble
    transformed_data[[paste0("FoliageC_Site", site)]] <- (lai_ens * 0.5) / sla_vec # LAI -> foliage C
    if (wood_var %in% names(year_data)) transformed_data[[paste0("WoodC_Site", site)]] <- year_data[[wood_var]] * 0.1 # wood C Mg/ha -> wood C kg/m2
  }
  analysis.transformed[[i]] <- transformed_data # store
}

# Convert each year's transformed data from list to df
for (i in seq_along(analysis.transformed)) analysis.transformed[[i]] <- as.data.frame(analysis.transformed[[i]])

# Assign names to transformed data
names(analysis.transformed) <- names(analysis.all)

# Create empty list for annual growth in carbon
annual_change <- vector("list", length = 12) # one for each year (2012-2024)
names(annual_change) <- names(analysis.transformed)[1:12]

# Loop through each year in analysis.transformed 
for (year in 1:12) {
  current_year_data <- analysis.transformed[[year]] # this year
  next_year_data <- analysis.transformed[[year + 1]] # next year
  year_change_data <- list() # change for this year
  # Loop through each site
  for (site in 1:8000) {
    foliage_col_current <- paste0("FoliageC_Site", site) # foliage this year
    wood_col_current <- paste0("WoodC_Site", site) # wood this year
    foliage_col_next <- paste0("FoliageC_Site", site) # foliage next year
    wood_col_next <- paste0("WoodC_Site", site) # wood next year
    if (foliage_col_current %in% names(current_year_data) && foliage_col_next %in% names(next_year_data) && wood_col_current %in% names(current_year_data) && wood_col_next %in% names(next_year_data)) {
      foliage_change <- next_year_data[[foliage_col_next]] - current_year_data[[foliage_col_current]] # foliage growth
      wood_change <- next_year_data[[wood_col_next]] - current_year_data[[wood_col_current]] # wood growth
      year_change_data[[paste0("FoliageChange_Site", site)]] <- foliage_change
      year_change_data[[paste0("WoodChange_Site", site)]] <- wood_change
      year_change_data[[paste0("TotalChange_Site", site)]] <- foliage_change + wood_change # total growth
    }
  }
  annual_change[[year]] <- year_change_data
}

# Convert each year's data to a data frame
for (year in 1:12) annual_change[[year]] <- as.data.frame(annual_change[[year]])

# List for mean and standard deviation of growth
model_growth_stats <- list()

# Loop through each year 
for (year in 1:12) {
  year_data <- annual_change[[year]]
  avg_foliage_growth <- numeric(135) # mean foliage growth
  avg_wood_growth <- numeric(135) # mean wood growth
  avg_total_growth <- numeric(135) # mean total growth 
  sd_foliage_growth <- numeric(135) # sd foliage growth
  sd_wood_growth <- numeric(135) # sd wood growth
  sd_total_growth <- numeric(135) # sd total growth
  for (site in 1:8000) {
    foliage_change_col <- paste0("FoliageChange_Site", site)
    wood_change_col <- paste0("WoodChange_Site", site)
    total_change_col <- paste0("TotalChange_Site", site)
    if (foliage_change_col %in% names(year_data) && wood_change_col %in% names(year_data) && total_change_col %in% names(year_data)) {
      avg_foliage_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[foliage_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      avg_wood_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[wood_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      avg_total_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[total_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_foliage_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[foliage_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_wood_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[wood_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_total_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[total_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  model_growth_stats[[paste0("Year_", names(analysis.transformed)[year])]] <- data.frame(Site = 1:8000,                                                               AvgFoliageGrowth = avg_foliage_growth,
          AvgWoodGrowth = avg_wood_growth,
          AvgTotalGrowth = avg_total_growth,
          SDFoliageGrowth = sd_foliage_growth,
          SDWoodGrowth = sd_wood_growth,
          SDTotalGrowth = sd_total_growth)
}

# Loop through each site
for (site in 1:8000) {
  foliage_growth_values <- numeric(12) # annual foliage growth 
  wood_growth_values <- numeric(12) # annual wood growth 
  total_growth_values <- numeric(12) # annual total growth 
  for (year_index in 1:12) {
    year_name <- paste0("Year_", names(analysis.transformed)[year_index]) # year label
    year_data <- model_growth_stats[[year_name]] # stats for this year
    foliage_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgFoliageGrowth[site]
    wood_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgWoodGrowth[site]
    total_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgTotalGrowth[site]
  }
  avg_foliage_growth <- mean(foliage_growth_values) # mean across years
  avg_wood_growth <- mean(wood_growth_values)
  avg_total_growth <- mean(total_growth_values)
  site_row <- which(growth_table$site_number == site) # match to obs table
  if (length(site_row) > 0) {
    growth_table$mod_fc[site_row] <- avg_foliage_growth
    growth_table$mod_wc[site_row] <- avg_wood_growth
    growth_table$mod_tc[site_row] <- avg_total_growth
  }
}
```

##### 1l. Calculate growth summary statistics 
```{r Calculate plot-level growth summary statistics, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# add residuals, bias, rmse, mae

# Calculate residuals
growth_table$fc_residual <- growth_table$obs_fc - growth_table$mod_fc
growth_table$wc_residual <- growth_table$obs_wc - growth_table$mod_wc
growth_table$tc_residual <- growth_table$obs_tc - growth_table$mod_tc

## Coniferous Summary Statistics
# Filter the dataset
con_growthdata <- growth_table[growth_table$pft == "boreal.coniferous", ]

# Calculate summary stats for filtered data
tc_bias_c <- mean(con_growthdata$tc_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
fc_bias_c <- mean(con_growthdata$fc_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
wc_bias_c <- mean(con_growthdata$wc_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
tc_MAE_c <- mean(abs(con_growthdata$tc_residual), na.rm = TRUE)
fc_MAE_c <- mean(abs(con_growthdata$fc_residual), na.rm = TRUE)
wc_MAE_c <- mean(abs(con_growthdata$wc_residual), na.rm = TRUE)
tc_RMSE_c <- sqrt(mean(con_growthdata$tc_residual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
fc_RMSE_c <- sqrt(mean(con_growthdata$fc_residual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
wc_RMSE_c <- sqrt(mean(con_growthdata$wc_residual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
TC_Rel_RMSE_c <- (tc_RMSE_c / (sd(con_growthdata$obs_tc)))
FC_Rel_RMSE_c <- (fc_RMSE_c / (sd(con_growthdata$obs_fc)))
WC_Rel_RMSE_c <- (wc_RMSE_c / (sd(con_growthdata$obs_wc)))

# Create table
Summary_Growth_Con <- data.frame(
  TC_bias = tc_bias_c,
  FC_bias = fc_bias_c,
  WC_bias = wc_bias_c,
  TC_MAE = tc_MAE_c,
  FC_MAE = fc_MAE_c,
  WC_MAE = wc_MAE_c,
  TC_RMSE = tc_RMSE_c,
  FC_RMSE = fc_RMSE_c,
  WC_RMSE = wc_RMSE_c,
  TC_Rel_RMSE = TC_Rel_RMSE_c,
  FC_Rel_RMSE = FC_Rel_RMSE_c,
  WC_Rel_RMSE = WC_Rel_RMSE_c
)

## Deciduous Summary Statistics
# Filter the dataset

# Calculate summary stats for filtered data

fc_bias_d <- mean(decid_growthdata$fc_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
wc_bias_d <- mean(decid_growthdata$wc_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
tc_MAE_d <- mean(abs(decid_growthdata$tc_residual), na.rm = TRUE)
fc_MAE_d <- mean(abs(decid_growthdata$fc_residual), na.rm = TRUE)
wc_MAE_d <- mean(abs(decid_growthdata$wc_residual), na.rm = TRUE)
tc_RMSE_d <- sqrt(mean(decid_growthdata$tc_residual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
fc_RMSE_d <- sqrt(mean(decid_growthdata$fc_residual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
wc_RMSE_d <- sqrt(mean(decid_growthdata$wc_residual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
TC_Rel_RMSE_d <- (tc_RMSE_d / (sd(decid_growthdata$obs_tc)))
FC_Rel_RMSE_d <- (fc_RMSE_d / (sd(decid_growthdata$obs_fc)))

# Create table
Summary_Growth_Decid <- data.frame(

  TC_MAE = tc_MAE_d,

## Overall Summary Statistics

fc_bias <- mean(growth_table$fc_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
wc_bias <- mean(growth_table$wc_residual, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r Plot-level predicted vs Observed FC and WC Histograms, echo=FALSE}
# Modeled Values #
# make empty vectors for model data across all site/year combos
all_lai_ens <- numeric(0)  # LAI -> foliage C
all_abv_ens <- numeric(0)  # AbvGrndWood -> woody C

# Get unique site/year combos
site_year_combinations <- unique(FIA_Model_Combined[, c("Closest_Site", "INVYR")])

# Loop through each site/year combo
for (i in 1:nrow(site_year_combinations)) {
  selected_site <- site_year_combinations$Closest_Site[i]  # site
  selected_year <- site_year_combinations$INVYR[i]  # year
  year_data <- analysis.fia[[as.character(selected_year)]]  # model df for this year
  lai_col <- paste0("LAI_Site_", selected_site)
  abv_col <- paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site_", selected_site)
  if (lai_col %in% colnames(year_data) && abv_col %in% colnames(year_data)) {
    pft_site <- sitepft$pft[match(as.numeric(selected_site), sitepft$site)]
    if (is.na(pft_site) || !(pft_site %in% names(filtered_samples))) {
      cat("Missing/unknown PFT for site", selected_site, "\n")
      next
    }
    sla_vec <- filtered_samples[[pft_site]]$SLA
    lai_raw <- year_data[[lai_col]]
    if (length(sla_vec) != length(lai_raw)) {
      stop("SLA length != ensemble length for site ", selected_site, " (pft=", pft_site, ")")
    }
    lai_ens <- 0.5 * lai_raw / sla_vec
    abv_ens <- 0.1 * year_data[[abv_col]]
    all_lai_ens <- c(all_lai_ens, lai_ens)
    all_abv_ens <- c(all_abv_ens, abv_ens)
  } else {
    cat("Missing columns for site", selected_site, "and year", selected_year, "\n")
  }
}
```

##### 2b. Predictive Quantile Histograms 
```{r Plot-level predictive Quantile Histograms, echo=FALSE}
### Predictive Quantile Histograms ###
# make vectors for predictive quantiles
predictive_quantiles_fc <- numeric(nrow(FIA_Model_Combined))  # foliage C
predictive_quantiles_wc <- numeric(nrow(FIA_Model_Combined))  # woody C

# Loop through observed data
for (i in seq_len(nrow(FIA_Model_Combined))) {
  site <- FIA_Model_Combined$Closest_Site[i]
  year <- as.character(FIA_Model_Combined$INVYR[i])
  obs_fc <- FIA_Model_Combined$FC_Obs[i]
  obs_wc <- FIA_Model_Combined$WC_Obs[i]
  model_year <- analysis.fia[[year]]  # model data for this year
  if (!is.null(model_year)) {
    lai_col <- paste0("LAI_Site", site)
    abv_col <- paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site", site)
    if (lai_col %in% colnames(model_year) && abv_col %in% colnames(model_year)) {
      lai_ens <- model_year[[lai_col]]
      abv_ens <- model_year[[abv_col]]
      sla <- filtered_samples[[FIA_Model_Combined$pft[i]]]$SLA  # SLA by PFT
      fc_model <- 0.5 * lai_ens / sla
      wc_model <- 0.1 * abv_ens
      predictive_quantiles_fc[i] <- sum(fc_model <= obs_fc, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(fc_model))
      predictive_quantiles_wc[i] <- sum(wc_model <= obs_wc, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(wc_model))
    } else {
      warning(paste("Site", site, "not found in model data for year", year))
    }
  } else {
    warning(paste("Year", year, "not found in model data"))
  }
}

# Add predictive quantiles to observed table
FIA_Model_Combined$Predictive_Quantile_FC <- predictive_quantiles_fc
FIA_Model_Combined$Predictive_Quantile_WC <- predictive_quantiles_wc

# Histograms #
# Foliage Carbon
par(family = "Times")
hist(FIA_Model_Combined$Predictive_Quantile_FC,

     xlab = "Predictive Quantile",
     ylab = "Frequency",
     col = "skyblue",
     border = "black",
     breaks = 15,
     xlim = c(0, 1),
     freq = TRUE)

# Woody Carbon
par(family = "Times")
hist(FIA_Model_Combined$Predictive_Quantile_WC,
     main = "Woody Carbon Predictive Quantiles",
     font.main = 1,
     xlab = "Predictive Quantile",
```

##### 2e. Maps of Error Relative to Pool Size for Ecoregions
```{r Plot-level relative error maps, echo=FALSE}
# Define regions
assign_region <- function(lat, lon) {
  if (lon >= -125 & lon < -102) {
    # West
    return("West")
  } else if (lon >= -102 & lon < -89) {
    # Midwest
    return("Midwest")
  } else if (lon >= -89 & lon < -75) {
    if (lat > 36) {
      return("Northeast")
    } else {
      return("South")
    }
  } else if (lon >= -75 & lon <= -66) {
    # Northeast
    return("Northeast")
  } else if (lon >= -102 & lon < -89 & lat < 36) {
    # South
    return("South")
  } else {
    return("Alaska")
  }
}

# Add region column

FIA_Model_Combined$FCResidual <- FIA_Model_Combined$FC_Obs - FIA_Model_Combined$FC_Mean_Mod
FIA_Model_Combined$WCResidual <- FIA_Model_Combined$WC_Obs - FIA_Model_Combined$WC_Mean_Mod

  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarize(Total_C_Pool = sum(Tot_C_Obs, na.rm = TRUE))

# Join pool size back onto plot table

  left_join(carbon_pool, by = "Region")

# Normalize pool sizes for plotting
```

```{r plot-level pred obs, echo=FALSE}
pfts_keep <- c("boreal.coniferous", "temperate.deciduous.HPDA")

# Closest site per plot (only within its PFT)

plot_summary$Closest_Site <- site_info_filtered$site_ids[nearest_site_index]

plot_summary <- plot_summary %>%

            by = c("Closest_Site" = "site_ids"))

## SDA + SLA

load("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/sda.all.forecast.analysis.Rdata")
load("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/samples.Rdata")

# Add site numbers to column names 
vars_per_site <- c("AbvGrndWood", "LAI", "SoilMoistFrac", "TotSoilCarb")
n_sites <- 8000
site_ids <- 1:n_sites
col_names <- unlist(lapply(site_ids, function(id) paste0(vars_per_site, "_Site_", id)))
for (t in seq_along(analysis.all)) { colnames(analysis.all[[t]]) <- col_names }

# Keep only AbvGrndWood + LAI
analysis.filtered <- lapply(analysis.all, function(mat) {
  cols <- colnames(mat)
  keep <- grepl("^AbvGrndWood($|_)", cols) | grepl("^LAI($|_)", cols)
  mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
})

# Helper to pull site id from colnames
extract_site <- function(x, prefix) sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_Site_"), "", x)

# Transform to WC/FC/TC per site-year 
analysis.transformed <- lapply(seq_along(analysis.filtered), function(i) {
  mat <- analysis.filtered[[i]]
  cols <- colnames(mat)
  agb_cols <- grep("^AbvGrndWood_Site_", cols, value = TRUE)
  lai_cols <- grep("^LAI_Site_", cols, value = TRUE)
  agb_sites <- extract_site(agb_cols, "AbvGrndWood")
  lai_sites <- extract_site(lai_cols, "LAI")
  common_sites <- intersect(agb_sites, lai_sites)
  if (length(common_sites) == 0) return(NULL)
  out_list <- vector("list", length(common_sites) * 3)
  k <- 1
  for (site in common_sites) { # Per site, use SLA vector for that site's PFT
    pft_site <- site_pft$pft[match(as.numeric(site), site_pft$site)]
    if (is.na(pft_site) || !(pft_site %in% names(ensemble.samples))) next
    sla_vec <- ensemble.samples[[pft_site]]$SLA
    lai_ens <- mat[, paste0("LAI_Site_", site), drop = TRUE]
    agb_ens <- mat[, paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site_", site), drop = TRUE]
    if (length(sla_vec) != length(lai_ens)) stop("SLA length != ensemble length for site ", site, " (pft=", pft_site, ")")
    WC_mod <- 0.1 * agb_ens
    FC_mod <- 0.5 * lai_ens / sla_vec
    TC_mod <- WC_mod + FC_mod
    out_list[[k]] <- WC_mod; names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("WC_mod_Site_", site); k <- k + 1
    out_list[[k]] <- FC_mod; names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("FC_mod_Site_", site); k <- k + 1
    out_list[[k]] <- TC_mod; names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("TC_mod_Site_", site); k <- k + 1
  }
  out_list <- out_list[!vapply(out_list, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (length(out_list) == 0) return(NULL)
  as.data.frame(out_list)
})
names(analysis.transformed) <- names(analysis.filtered)

# Make model means table 
mean_df_list <- lapply(names(analysis.transformed), function(yr) {
  mat <- analysis.transformed[[yr]]
  if (is.null(mat)) return(NULL)
  means <- colMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(Year = yr, Variable = names(means), Mean = as.numeric(means), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
plot_summary_mod <- bind_rows(mean_df_list) %>%
  tidyr::separate(Variable, into = c("Variable", "Site"), sep = "_Site_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Site, Variable, Mean)

# Prep model table for join
plot_summary_mod_clean <- plot_summary_mod %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(str_sub(Year, 1, 4))) %>%
  rename(INVYR = Year, Closest_Site = Site) %>%
  dplyr::select(INVYR, Closest_Site, Variable, Mean)
plot_summary_mod_wide <- plot_summary_mod_clean %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = Mean)

# Join modeled means onto plot obs
plot_summary <- plot_summary %>%
  mutate(Closest_Site = as.character(Closest_Site)) %>%
  left_join(plot_summary_mod_wide, by = c("INVYR", "Closest_Site"))

# Average across plots per site
plot_summary_avg <- plot_summary %>%
  group_by(Closest_Site, pft) %>%
  summarize(across(c(WC_obs, FC_obs, TC_obs, WC_mod, FC_mod, TC_mod), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Helper to build hex plot + RMA + % off 1:1
make_hex_plot <- function(plot_summary_avg, pft_label, plot_title) {
  plot_data <- plot_summary_avg %>%
    dplyr::select(Closest_Site, pft, WC_obs, FC_obs, TC_obs, WC_mod, FC_mod, TC_mod) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(Closest_Site, pft),
                 names_to = c("Variable", "Type"),
                 names_sep = "_",
                 values_to = "Value") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Value) %>%
    rename(Obs = obs, Mod = mod) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Obs), !is.na(Mod))
  rma_results <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    summarise(
      r  = cor(Obs, Mod, use = "complete.obs"),
      sx = sd(Obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      sy = sd(Mod, na.rm = TRUE),
      slope = sy / sx,
      intercept = mean(Mod, na.rm = TRUE) - slope * mean(Obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      R2 = r^2,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  rma_pct_row <- rma_results %>%
    mutate(Variable = toupper(Variable), pct_off = (slope - 1) * 100) %>%
    select(Variable, pct_off) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = pct_off) %>%
    mutate(PFT = pft_label) %>%
    mutate(
      WC = ifelse(!"WC" %in% names(.), NA_real_, WC),
      FC = ifelse(!"FC" %in% names(.), NA_real_, FC),
      TC = ifelse(!"TC" %in% names(.), NA_real_, TC)
    ) %>%
    select(PFT, WC, FC, TC)
  lims <- quantile(c(plot_data$Obs, plot_data$Mod), probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot_data_trim <- plot_data %>%
    filter(Obs >= lims[1], Obs <= lims[2], Mod >= lims[1], Mod <= lims[2])
  p <- ggplot(plot_data_trim, aes(x = Obs, y = Mod)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hex(bins = 40) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", name = "Point density", trans = "log10", direction = -1, limits = c(1, 100)) +
    geom_abline(data = rma_results, aes(intercept = intercept, slope = slope), color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_text(data = rma_results, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R\u00B2 = ", sprintf("%.2f", R2))),
              hjust = 1.1, vjust = 25, size = 4, family = "Times New Roman", fontface = "plain") +
    facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Observed Biomass (kg C/m²)", y = "Predicted Biomass (kg C/m²)", title = plot_title) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "plain"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain")
    )
  list(plot = p, rma = rma_results, pct = rma_pct_row)
}

# Coniferous plot
plot_summary_avg_con <- plot_summary_avg %>% filter(pft == "boreal.coniferous")
res_con <- make_hex_plot(plot_summary_avg_con, "boreal.coniferous", "Observed vs Predicted Plot-Level Biomass (Coniferous)")
print(res_con$plot)
plot_normal_pct <- bind_rows(plot_normal_pct, res_con$pct)

# Deciduous plot

res_dec <- make_hex_plot(plot_summary_avg_dec, "temperate.deciduous.HPDA", "Observed vs Predicted Plot-Level Biomass (Deciduous)")
print(res_dec$plot)
plot_normal_pct <- bind_rows(plot_normal_pct, res_dec$pct)

# All PFTs plot
res_all <- make_hex_plot(plot_summary_avg, "both", "Observed vs Predicted Plot-Level Biomass (All PFTs)")
print(res_all$plot)
plot_normal_pct <- bind_rows(plot_normal_pct, res_all$pct)

print(plot_normal_pct)
gc()
```

```{r Growth plot-level pred obs, echo=FALSE}
site_coords <- as.matrix(site_info_filtered[, c("lat", "lon")])
dist_matrix <- spDists(plot_coords, site_coords, longlat = TRUE)
nearest_site_index <- apply(dist_matrix, 1, which.min)
plot_summary$Closest_Site <- site_info_filtered$site_ids[nearest_site_index]

plot_summary <- plot_summary %>%
  left_join(site_info_filtered %>% dplyr::select(site_ids, pft),
            by = c("Closest_Site" = "site_ids"))

load("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/samples.Rdata")

library(dplyr)

growth_table <- plot_summary %>%
  group_by(Closest_Site, INVYR) %>%
  summarise(
    WC_obs = mean(WC_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
    FC_obs = mean(FC_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
    TC_obs = mean(TC_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
    LAT    = mean(LAT, na.rm = TRUE),
    LON    = mean(LON, na.rm = TRUE),
    pft    = first(pft),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Closest_Site, INVYR) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(INVYR) > 1) %>%
  group_by(Closest_Site) %>%
  mutate(
    year_diff = INVYR - lag(INVYR),
    obs_wc = (WC_obs - lag(WC_obs)) / year_diff,
    obs_fc = (FC_obs - lag(FC_obs)) / year_diff,
    obs_tc = (TC_obs - lag(TC_obs)) / year_diff,
    year_range = paste0(lag(INVYR), "-", INVYR)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(obs_tc)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Trim 
wc_cutoff <- quantile(growth_table$obs_wc, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
tc_cutoff <- quantile(growth_table$obs_tc, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

growth_table <- growth_table %>%
  filter(obs_wc <= wc_cutoff, obs_tc <= tc_cutoff)

# Model transformation
analysis.transformed <- vector("list", length(analysis.all))
names(analysis.transformed) <- names(analysis.all)

filtered_samples <- ensemble.samples[c("temperate.deciduous.HPDA", "boreal.coniferous")]
sitepft <- read.csv("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/site_pft.csv", header = TRUE)

for (i in seq_along(analysis.all)) {
  year_data <- analysis.all[[i]]
  transformed_data <- list()
  for (site in 1:8000) { 
    wood_var <- paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site_", site)
    lai_var <- paste0("LAI_Site_", site)
    site_pft <- sitepft[as.numeric(site), "pft"]
    if (!site_pft %in% names(filtered_samples)) next
    sla_vec <- filtered_samples[[site_pft]]$SLA
    if (wood_var %in% names(year_data)) {
      transformed_data[[paste0("WoodC_Site", site)]] <- year_data[[wood_var]] * 0.1
    }
    transformed_data[[paste0("FoliageC_Site", site)]] <- (year_data[[lai_var]] * 0.5) / sla_vec
  }
  analysis.transformed[[i]] <- transformed_data
}

for (i in seq_along(analysis.transformed)) {
  analysis.transformed[[i]] <- as.data.frame(analysis.transformed[[i]])
}

# Annual change/growth by year 
annual_change <- vector("list", length = 12)
names(annual_change) <- names(analysis.transformed)[1:12]

for (year in 1:12) {
  current_year_data <- analysis.transformed[[year]]
  next_year_data <- analysis.transformed[[year + 1]]
  year_change_data <- list()
  for (site in 1:8000) { # Per site, take ensemble diffs
    foliage_col_current <- paste0("FoliageC_Site", site)
    wood_col_current <- paste0("WoodC_Site", site)
    foliage_col_next <- paste0("FoliageC_Site", site)
    wood_col_next <- paste0("WoodC_Site", site)
    if (foliage_col_current %in% names(current_year_data) && foliage_col_next %in% names(next_year_data) &&
        wood_col_current %in% names(current_year_data) && wood_col_next %in% names(next_year_data)) {
      foliage_change <- next_year_data[[foliage_col_next]] - current_year_data[[foliage_col_current]]
      wood_change <- next_year_data[[wood_col_next]] - current_year_data[[wood_col_current]]
      year_change_data[[paste0("FoliageChange_Site", site)]] <- foliage_change
      year_change_data[[paste0("WoodChange_Site", site)]] <- wood_change
      year_change_data[[paste0("TotalChange_Site", site)]] <- foliage_change + wood_change
    }
  }
  annual_change[[year]] <- year_change_data
}

for (year in 1:12) {
  annual_change[[year]] <- as.data.frame(annual_change[[year]])
}

names(annual_change) <- names(analysis.transformed)[1:12]

# Growth stats per year
model_growth_stats <- list()

for (year in 1:12) {
  year_data <- annual_change[[year]]
  avg_foliage_growth <- numeric(8000)
  avg_wood_growth <- numeric(8000)
  avg_total_growth <- numeric(8000)
  sd_foliage_growth <- numeric(8000)
  sd_wood_growth <- numeric(8000)
  sd_total_growth <- numeric(8000)
  for (site in 1:8000) { # Per site, summarize across ensemble
    foliage_change_col <- paste0("FoliageChange_Site", site)
    wood_change_col <- paste0("WoodChange_Site", site)
    total_change_col <- paste0("TotalChange_Site", site)
    if (foliage_change_col %in% names(year_data) && wood_change_col %in% names(year_data) && total_change_col %in% names(year_data)) {
      avg_foliage_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[foliage_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      avg_wood_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[wood_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      avg_total_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[total_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_foliage_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[foliage_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_wood_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[wood_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_total_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[total_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  model_growth_stats[[paste0("Year_", names(analysis.transformed)[year])]] <- data.frame(
    Site = 1:8000,
    AvgFoliageGrowth = avg_foliage_growth,
    AvgWoodGrowth = avg_wood_growth,
    AvgTotalGrowth = avg_total_growth,
    SDFoliageGrowth = sd_foliage_growth,
    SDWoodGrowth = sd_wood_growth,
    SDTotalGrowth = sd_total_growth
  )
}

growth_table$mod_fc <- NA
growth_table$mod_wc <- NA
growth_table$mod_tc <- NA

for (site in 1:8000) {
  foliage_growth_values <- numeric(12)
  wood_growth_values <- numeric(12)
  total_growth_values <- numeric(12)
  for (year_index in 1:12) {
    year_name <- paste0("Year_", names(analysis.transformed)[year_index])
    year_data <- model_growth_stats[[year_name]]
    foliage_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgFoliageGrowth[site]
    wood_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgWoodGrowth[site]
    total_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgTotalGrowth[site]
  }
  avg_foliage_growth <- mean(foliage_growth_values)
  avg_wood_growth <- mean(wood_growth_values)
  avg_total_growth <- mean(total_growth_values)
  site_row <- which(growth_table$Closest_Site == site)
  if (length(site_row) > 0) {
    growth_table$mod_fc[site_row] <- avg_foliage_growth
    growth_table$mod_wc[site_row] <- avg_wood_growth
    growth_table$mod_tc[site_row] <- avg_total_growth
  }
}

# Residuals
growth_table$fc_residual <- growth_table$obs_fc - growth_table$mod_fc
growth_table$wc_residual <- growth_table$obs_wc - growth_table$mod_wc
growth_table$tc_residual <- growth_table$obs_tc - growth_table$mod_tc

library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(tibble)

# Results table for growth RMA slopes
plot_growth <- tibble(
  PFT      = character(),
  Variable = character(),
  slope    = double(),
  R2       = double(),
  pct_off  = double()
)

# Hex plot helper 
make_hex_plot <- function(df, pft_filter = NULL, title_suffix = "Overall") {
  if (!is.null(pft_filter)) { df_use <- df %>% filter(pft == pft_filter); pft_label <- pft_filter } else { df_use <- df; pft_label <- "Overall" }
  plot_data <- df_use %>%
    dplyr::select(Closest_Site, pft, obs_wc, obs_fc, obs_tc, mod_wc, mod_fc, mod_tc) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(Closest_Site, pft), names_to = c("Type", "Variable"), names_sep = "_", values_to = "Value") %>%
    group_by(Closest_Site, pft, Variable, Type) %>%
    summarise(Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Value) %>%
    rename(Obs = obs, Mod = mod) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Obs), !is.na(Mod)) %>%
    mutate(Variable = toupper(Variable))
  rma_results <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    summarise(
      r  = cor(Obs, Mod, use = "complete.obs"),
      sx = sd(Obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      sy = sd(Mod, na.rm = TRUE),
      slope = (sy / sx),
      intercept = mean(Mod, na.rm = TRUE) - slope * mean(Obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      R2 = r^2,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  plot_growth_pct <- rma_results %>%
    mutate(PFT = pft_label, pct_off = (slope - 1) * 100) %>%
    dplyr::select(PFT, Variable, slope, R2, pct_off)
  plot_growth <<- bind_rows(plot_growth, plot_growth_pct)
  print(plot_growth_pct)
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Obs, y = Mod)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hex(bins = 40) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", name = "Point density", trans = "log10", direction = -1, limits = c(1, 100)) +
    geom_abline(data = rma_results, aes(intercept = intercept, slope = slope), color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_text(data = rma_results, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R\u00B2 = ", sprintf("%.2f", R2))),
              hjust = 1.1, vjust = 27, size = 4, family = "Times New Roman") +
    facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Observed Growth (kg C/m²/yr)", y = "Predicted Growth (kg C/m²/yr)",
         title = paste("Observed vs Predicted Plot-Level Growth -", title_suffix)) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "plain"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain")
    )
}

hex_con <- make_hex_plot(growth_table, "boreal.coniferous", "Boreal Coniferous")
hex_dec <- make_hex_plot(growth_table, "temperate.deciduous.HPDA", "Temperate Deciduous")
hex_all <- make_hex_plot(growth_table, NULL, "Overall")

hex_con
hex_dec
hex_all
gc()
```

##### *2h. County-Level Pred vs Obs Plots 
```{r county-level pred obs, echo=FALSE}
# Note: This is a hex plot and color is log-scaled

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(lmodel2)

# Helper to build county-level pred obs plot
make_county_hex_plot <- function(
  FilteredTREECounty_df,
  ModSummary,
  pft_label,
  mod_cols,
  plot_title
) {
  FilteredTREECounty_df$TPM2 <- FilteredTREECounty_df$TPA_UNADJ / 4046.86

  latest_cycle <- FilteredTREECounty_df %>%
    group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD) %>%
    filter(INVYR == max(INVYR)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(STATECD, COUNTYCD, CYCLE)

  FilteredTREECounty_df <- FilteredTREECounty_df %>%
    inner_join(latest_cycle, by = c("STATECD", "COUNTYCD", "CYCLE"))

  # Plot estimates
  plot_summary <- FilteredTREECounty_df %>%
    group_by(PLT_CN, COUNTYCD, STATECD, STRATUM_CN, INVYR, EXPNS) %>%
    summarize(
      WC_plot = sum(
        CARBON_AG * TPA_UNADJ * 0.45359237 * 0.0002471 * ADJ_FACTOR_SUBP,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      FC_plot = sum(
        DRYBIO_FOLIAGE * 0.5 * TPA_UNADJ * 0.45359237 * 0.0002471 * ADJ_FACTOR_SUBP,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Stratum means and variances 
  stratum_summary <- plot_summary %>%
    group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, STRATUM_CN, EXPNS) %>%
    summarize(
      WC_stratum = mean(WC_plot, na.rm = TRUE),
      FC_stratum = mean(FC_plot, na.rm = TRUE),
      WC_var = ifelse(n() > 1, var(WC_plot, na.rm = TRUE) / n(), 0),
      FC_var = ifelse(n() > 1, var(FC_plot, na.rm = TRUE) / n(), 0),
      Cov_WC_FC = ifelse(n() > 1, cov(WC_plot, FC_plot, use = "complete.obs") / n(), 0),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # County weighted means and variances
  TREECountyObs <- stratum_summary %>%
    group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD) %>%
    summarize(
      WC_Obs = sum(WC_stratum * EXPNS) / sum(EXPNS),
      FC_Obs = sum(FC_stratum * EXPNS) / sum(EXPNS),
      TC_Obs = WC_Obs + FC_Obs,
      WC_Var = sum((EXPNS^2) * WC_var) / (sum(EXPNS)^2),
      FC_Var = sum((EXPNS^2) * FC_var) / (sum(EXPNS)^2),
      Cov_WC_FC = sum((EXPNS^2) * Cov_WC_FC) / (sum(EXPNS)^2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(TC_Var = WC_Var + FC_Var + 2 * Cov_WC_FC)

  ModSummary <- ModSummary %>%
    mutate(
      STATEFP = as.character(STATEFP),
      COUNTYFP = as.character(COUNTYFP)
    )

  TREECountyObs <- TREECountyObs %>%
    mutate(
      STATEFP = as.character(STATECD),
      COUNTYFP = as.character(COUNTYCD)
    )

  County_Biomass_Combined <- TREECountyObs %>%
    left_join(
      ModSummary %>%
        dplyr::select(
          STATEFP,
          COUNTYFP,
          all_of(mod_cols$TC),
          all_of(mod_cols$WC),
          all_of(mod_cols$FC)
        ),
      by = c("STATEFP", "COUNTYFP")
    )

  plot_data <- bind_rows(
    County_Biomass_Combined %>%
      transmute(
        STATECD, COUNTYCD,
        Variable = "TC",
        Obs = TC_Obs,
        Mod = .data[[mod_cols$TC]],
        Var = TC_Var
      ),
    County_Biomass_Combined %>%
      transmute(
        STATECD, COUNTYCD,
        Variable = "WC",
        Obs = WC_Obs,
        Mod = .data[[mod_cols$WC]],
        Var = WC_Var
      ),
    County_Biomass_Combined %>%
      transmute(
        STATECD, COUNTYCD,
        Variable = "FC",
        Obs = FC_Obs,
        Mod = .data[[mod_cols$FC]],
        Var = FC_Var
      )
  ) %>%
    mutate(Precision = 1 / Var)

  mod_cutoff <- quantile(plot_data$Obs, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

  plot_data_trimmed <- plot_data %>%
    filter(Obs <= mod_cutoff, is.finite(Precision), Precision > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      Precision_capped = pmin(Precision, quantile(Precision, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)),
      Precision_scaled = scales::rescale(Precision_capped, to = c(2, 10)),
      Precision_scaled_weight = scales::rescale(Precision_capped, to = c(0.1, 1)),
      label_y = case_when(
        Variable == "TC" ~ 0.95,
        Variable == "WC" ~ 0.85,
        Variable == "FC" ~ 0.75,
        TRUE ~ 0.5
      )
    )

  # RMA regression for each variable
  rma_results <- plot_data_trimmed %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    summarise(
      r = cor(Obs, Mod, use = "complete.obs"),
      sx = sd(Obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      sy = sd(Mod, na.rm = TRUE),
      slope = sign(r) * (sy / sx),
      intercept = mean(Mod, na.rm = TRUE) - slope * mean(Obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      R2 = r^2,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Summary table for each variable
  county_normal <- rma_results %>%
    mutate(
      PFT = pft_label,
      slope_percent_off = (slope - 1) * 100
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(PFT, Variable, slope, slope_percent_off, R2)

  p <- ggplot(plot_data_trimmed, aes(x = Obs, y = Mod)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hex(bins = 40) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "D",
      name = "Point density",
      trans = "log10",
      direction = -1,
      limits = c(1, 100)
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      data = rma_results,
      aes(intercept = intercept, slope = slope),
      color = "black", linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = rma_results,
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R² = ", sprintf("%.2f", R2))),
      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 25, size = 4, family = "Times New Roman"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      x = "Observed Biomass (kg C/m²)",
      y = "Predicted Biomass (kg C/m²)",
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  list(plot = p, table = county_normal, data = plot_data_trimmed, rma = rma_results)
}

# Modeled county summary
ModSummary <- read.csv("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/GEDI_SDA/county_summary_mod.csv")

# Coniferous
res_con <- make_county_hex_plot(
  FilteredTREECounty_df = FilteredTREECountyCon,
  ModSummary = ModSummary,
  pft_label = "boreal.coniferous",
  mod_cols = list(TC = "TC_Mod_avg_con", WC = "WC_Mod_avg_con", FC = "FC_Mod_avg_con"),
  plot_title = "Observed vs Predicted Biomass Density by Pool (Coniferous)"
)
print(res_con$plot)
print(res_con$table)

# Deciduous
res_dec <- make_county_hex_plot(
  FilteredTREECounty_df = FilteredTREECountyDec,
  ModSummary = ModSummary,
  pft_label = "temperate.deciduous.HPDA",
  mod_cols = list(TC = "TC_Mod_avg_dec", WC = "WC_Mod_avg_dec", FC = "FC_Mod_avg_dec"),
  plot_title = "Observed vs Predicted Biomass Density by Pool (Deciduous)"
)
print(res_dec$plot)
print(res_dec$table)

# Overall
res_all <- make_county_hex_plot(
  FilteredTREECounty_df = FilteredTREECounty,
  ModSummary = ModSummary,
  pft_label = "both",
  mod_cols = list(TC = "TC_Mod_avg", WC = "WC_Mod_avg", FC = "FC_Mod_avg"),
  plot_title = "Observed vs Predicted Biomass Density by Pool (Overall)"
)
print(res_all$plot)
print(res_all$table)

gc()
```

```{r county-level pred obs, echo=FALSE}
# Note: This is a hex plot and color is log-scaled

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)

FilteredTREECounty <- read.csv("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/FIA/FilteredTREECounty.csv.gz")

# Add PFT
FilteredTREECounty <- (function(df) {
  cols <- names(df)
  src <- intersect(c("pft", "ClassCode", "ClassCode.x", "ClassCode.y"), cols)
  if (length(src) == 0) stop("No ClassCode/pft column found in FilteredTREECounty.")
  src <- src[1]

  df %>%
    mutate(
      pft = case_when(
        .data[[src]] %in% c("Con", 1, "1")   ~ "boreal.coniferous",
        .data[[src]] %in% c("Decid", 4, "4") ~ "temperate.deciduous.HPDA",
        TRUE ~ as.character(.data[[src]])
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("ClassCode", "ClassCode.x", "ClassCode.y")))
})(FilteredTREECounty)

# County biomass by year and PFT
county_biomass_pft <- FilteredTREECounty %>%
  filter(!is.na(pft)) %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, INVYR, STRATUM_CN, EXPNS, pft) %>%
  summarise(
    WC_stratum = sum(
      0.1 * CARBON_AG * TPA_UNADJ * 0.45359237 * 0.0002471 * ADJ_FACTOR_SUBP,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    FC_stratum = sum(
      0.1 * DRYBIO_FOLIAGE * 0.5 * TPA_UNADJ * 0.45359237 * 0.0002471 * ADJ_FACTOR_SUBP,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, INVYR, pft) %>%
  summarise(
    WC_Obs = sum(WC_stratum * EXPNS) / sum(EXPNS),
    FC_Obs = sum(FC_stratum * EXPNS) / sum(EXPNS),
    TC_Obs = WC_Obs + FC_Obs,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Annual growth at county and PFT levels
county_growth_pft <- county_biomass_pft %>%
  arrange(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft, INVYR) %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft) %>%
  mutate(
    year_diff = INVYR - lag(INVYR),
    growth_wc = (WC_Obs - lag(WC_Obs)),
    growth_fc = (FC_Obs - lag(FC_Obs)),
    growth_tc = (TC_Obs - lag(TC_Obs)),
    year_range = paste0(lag(INVYR), "-", INVYR)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(growth_tc)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Annualized intervals
county_growth_expanded_pft <- county_growth_pft %>%
  mutate(year_range = str_trim(year_range)) %>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_regex(
    year_range,
    patterns = c(start = "\\d{4}", "-", end = "\\d{4}")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start = as.integer(start),
    end   = as.integer(end),
    n_intervals = pmax(end - start, 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(n_intervals > 0) %>%
  mutate(year_end_vec = map2(start, end, ~ seq(.x + 1L, .y, by = 1L))) %>%
  unnest(year_end_vec) %>%
  mutate(
    annual_growth_tc = growth_tc / n_intervals,
    annual_growth_wc = growth_wc / n_intervals,
    annual_growth_fc = growth_fc / n_intervals,
    year_end = year_end_vec
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft, year_end, annual_growth_tc, annual_growth_wc, annual_growth_fc)

# County mean annual growth by PFT
county_annual_mean_obs <- county_growth_expanded_pft %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_tc_growth = mean(annual_growth_tc, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_wc_growth = mean(annual_growth_wc, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_fc_growth = mean(annual_growth_fc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

compute_model_county_mean <- function(tif_dir, counties_sf, band = 2) {

  pools <- c("WC", "FC", "TC")
  results <- list()

  for (pool in pools) {
    message("Processing ", pool, " rasters...")

    tif_files <- list.files(
      tif_dir,
      pattern = paste0("^", pool, "_\\d{4}\\.(tif|tiff)$"),
      full.names = TRUE
    )
    if (length(tif_files) <= 1) next

    years <- as.integer(sub(
      paste0("^", pool, "_(\\d{4})\\.(tif|tiff)$"),
      "\\1",
      basename(tif_files)
    ))
    ord <- order(years)
    tif_files <- tif_files[ord]
    years <- years[ord]

    r_list <- lapply(tif_files, function(f) rast(f)[[band]])
    r_stack <- rast(r_list)
    names(r_stack) <- paste0(pool, "_", years)

    r_growth <- r_stack[[2:nlyr(r_stack)]] - r_stack[[1:(nlyr(r_stack) - 1)]]
    names(r_growth) <- paste0("g_", pool, "_", years[-1], "_minus_", years[-length(years)])

    counties_use <- st_transform(counties_sf, crs(r_stack))
    ez <- terra::extract(r_growth, vect(counties_use), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

    mod_long <- counties_use %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
      dplyr::select(STATEFP, COUNTYFP, ID) %>%
      inner_join(ez, by = "ID") %>%
      dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
      pivot_longer(starts_with("g_"), names_to = "layer", values_to = "mod_growth") %>%
      mutate(year = as.integer(str_match(layer, paste0("_(\\d{4})_minus_"))[, 2])) %>%
      dplyr::select(STATEFP, COUNTYFP, year, mod_growth)

    mod_mean <- mod_long %>%
      group_by(STATEFP, COUNTYFP) %>%
      summarise(mean_growth = mean(mod_growth, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(
        STATECD = as.character(as.integer(STATEFP)),
        COUNTYCD = as.character(as.integer(COUNTYFP))
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(STATECD, COUNTYCD, mean_growth)

    results[[pool]] <- mod_mean %>%
      rename(!!paste0("mod_", tolower(pool), "_annual_mean") := mean_growth)
  }

  mod_county_mean <- reduce(results, full_join, by = c("STATECD", "COUNTYCD"))
  list(mod_county_mean = mod_county_mean)
}

make_county_hex_plot <- function(df, pft_filter = NULL, title_suffix = "All PFTs") {
  if (!is.null(pft_filter)) {
    df <- df %>% filter(pft == pft_filter)
  }
  plot_data <- df %>%
    mutate(
      obs_wc = mean_wc_growth,
      obs_fc = mean_fc_growth,
      obs_tc = mean_tc_growth,
      mod_wc = case_when(
        pft == "boreal.coniferous"         ~ mod_wc_annual_mean_con,
        pft == "temperate.deciduous.HPDA"  ~ mod_wc_annual_mean_dec
      ),
      mod_fc = case_when(
        pft == "boreal.coniferous"         ~ mod_fc_annual_mean_con,
        pft == "temperate.deciduous.HPDA"  ~ mod_fc_annual_mean_dec
      ),
      mod_tc = case_when(
        pft == "boreal.coniferous"         ~ mod_tc_annual_mean_con,
        pft == "temperate.deciduous.HPDA"  ~ mod_tc_annual_mean_dec
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft,
      obs_wc, obs_fc, obs_tc,
      mod_wc, mod_fc, mod_tc
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(obs_tc), is.finite(mod_tc))

  plot_data_long <- plot_data %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft),
      names_to = c("Type", "Variable"),
      names_sep = "_",
      values_to = "Value"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = Value) %>%
    rename(Obs = obs, Mod = mod) %>%
    mutate(Variable = toupper(Variable)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Obs), !is.na(Mod))

  lims <- stats::quantile(
    c(plot_data_long$Obs, plot_data_long$Mod),
    probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  plot_data_long <- plot_data_long %>%
    filter(
      Obs >= lims[1], Obs <= lims[2],
      Mod >= lims[1], Mod <= lims[2]
    )

  rma_results <- plot_data_long %>%
    group_by(Variable) %>%
    summarise(
      r = stats::cor(Obs, Mod, use = "complete.obs"),
      sx = stats::sd(Obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      sy = stats::sd(Mod, na.rm = TRUE),
      slope = sy / sx,
      intercept = mean(Mod, na.rm = TRUE) - slope * mean(Obs, na.rm = TRUE),
      R2 = r^2,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(percent_off = (slope - 1) * 100)

  rma_summary_table <- rma_results %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable, percent_off) %>%
    mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c("FC", "WC", "TC"))) %>%
    arrange(Variable) %>%
    mutate(Variable = as.character(Variable)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = percent_off) %>%
    mutate(PFT = if (is.null(pft_filter)) "All PFTs" else pft_filter) %>%
    dplyr::select(PFT, FC, WC, TC)

  cat("\nRMA slope % deviation from 1:1 (slope = 1) for ", title_suffix, ":\n", sep = "")
  print(rma_summary_table)

  ggplot(plot_data_long, aes(x = Obs, y = Mod)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hex(bins = 40) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "D",
      name = "Point density",
      trans = "log10",
      direction = -1,
      limits = c(1, 100)
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      data = rma_results,
      aes(intercept = intercept, slope = slope),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = rma_results,
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("R\u00B2 = ", sprintf("%.2f", R2))),
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = 27,
      size = 4,
      family = "Times New Roman"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      x = "Observed Growth (kg C/m²/yr)",
      y = "Predicted Growth (kg C/m²/yr)",
      title = paste("Observed vs Predicted County-Level Growth —", title_suffix)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "plain"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain")
    )
}
```

```{r Plot-level residual maps, echo=FALSE}
  colnames(analysis.all[[t]]) <- col_names
}

# Keep only AbvGrndWood and LAI
analysis.filtered <- lapply(analysis.all, function(mat) {
  cols <- colnames(mat)
  keep <- grepl("^AbvGrndWood($|_)", cols) | grepl("^LAI($|_)", cols)
  mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
})

# Helper to pull site ID from variable names
extract_site <- function(x, prefix) {
  sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_Site_"), "", x)
}

# PFT lookup by site id 
site_to_pft <- setNames(site_pft$pft, as.character(site_pft$site))

# Model ransformations
analysis.transformed <- lapply(seq_along(analysis.filtered), function(i) {
  mat <- analysis.filtered[[i]]
  cols <- colnames(mat)
  agb_cols <- grep("^AbvGrndWood_Site_", cols, value = TRUE)
  lai_cols <- grep("^LAI_Site_", cols, value = TRUE)
  agb_sites <- extract_site(agb_cols, "AbvGrndWood")
  lai_sites <- extract_site(lai_cols, "LAI")
  common_sites <- intersect(agb_sites, lai_sites)

  if (length(common_sites) == 0) return(NULL)

  out_list <- vector("list", length(common_sites) * 3)
  k <- 1

  for (site in common_sites) {
    pft_site <- site_to_pft[[as.character(site)]]
    if (is.null(pft_site) || is.na(pft_site)) next
    if (!(pft_site %in% names(ensemble.samples))) next

    sla_vec <- ensemble.samples[[pft_site]]$SLA

    lai_ens <- mat[, paste0("LAI_Site_", site), drop = TRUE]
    agb_ens <- mat[, paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site_", site), drop = TRUE]

    if (length(sla_vec) != length(lai_ens)) {
      stop(
        "SLA length does not match ensemble length for site ",
        site,
        " (pft = ",
        pft_site,
        ")."
      )
    }

    WC_mod <- 0.1 * agb_ens
    FC_mod <- 0.5 * lai_ens / sla_vec
    TC_mod <- WC_mod + FC_mod

    out_list[[k]] <- WC_mod
    names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("WC_mod_Site_", site)
    k <- k + 1

    out_list[[k]] <- FC_mod
    names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("FC_mod_Site_", site)
    k <- k + 1

    out_list[[k]] <- TC_mod
    names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("TC_mod_Site_", site)
    k <- k + 1
  }

  out_list <- out_list[!vapply(out_list, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (length(out_list) == 0) return(NULL)

  as.data.frame(out_list)
})

  data.frame(
    Year = yr,
    Variable = names(means),
    Mean = as.numeric(means),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

## Plot

us_map <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf")
us_union <- st_union(us_map)

global_lims <- stats::quantile(abs(plot_summary_avg$TC_res), probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
size_cap <- 40

prep_residual_df <- function(data, pft_name = NULL, lim_upper = global_lims, size_cap = 40) {
  dat <- data
  if (!is.null(pft_name)) dat <- dat %>% filter(pft == pft_name)

  dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(TC_res), !is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>%
    st_filter(us_union, .predicate = st_within) %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    mutate(
      abs_res = abs(TC_res),
      keep = abs_res <= lim_upper,
      ResidualSign = case_when(
        TC_res > 0 ~ "Positive",
        TC_res < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Col = case_when(
        ResidualSign == "Positive" ~ "royalblue",
        ResidualSign == "Negative" ~ "orangered1",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      TC_res_clipped = pmin(abs_res, size_cap)
    ) %>%
    filter(keep, !is.na(ResidualSign), !is.na(Col))
}

plot_pft_map <- function(
  data,
  pft_name,
  title_suffix = NULL,
  lim_upper = global_lims,
  size_cap = 40
) {
  df_plot <- prep_residual_df(data, pft_name, lim_upper, size_cap)

  ggplot(data = us_map) +
    geom_sf(fill = "lightgrey", color = "black", size = 0.1) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_plot,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = Col, size = TC_res_clipped),
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    scale_color_identity(
      name = "Residual sign",
      breaks = c("royalblue", "orangered1"),
      labels = c("Positive", "Negative"),
      guide = "legend"
    ) +
    scale_size(
      range = c(0.005, 1.7),
      limits = c(0, size_cap),
      name = "Residual Magnitude (kg C/m²)"
    ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-170, -60), ylim = c(20, 72)) +
    labs(
      title = ifelse(is.null(title_suffix), pft_name, title_suffix),
      x = "Longitude",
      y = "Latitude"
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        direction = "horizontal"
      ),
      size = guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        direction = "horizontal"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

plot_all_residuals <- function(
  data,
  title = "All Sites",
  lim_upper = global_lims,
  size_cap = 40
) {
  df_plot <- prep_residual_df(data, pft_name = NULL, lim_upper, size_cap)

  ggplot(data = us_map) +
    geom_sf(fill = "lightgrey", color = "black", size = 0.1) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_plot,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = Col, size = TC_res_clipped),
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    scale_color_identity(
      name = "Residual sign",
      breaks = c("royalblue", "orangered1"),
      labels = c("Positive", "Negative"),
      guide = "legend"
    ) +
    scale_size(
      range = c(0.005, 1.7),
      limits = c(0, size_cap),
      name = "Residual Magnitude (kg C/m²)"
    ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-170, -60), ylim = c(20, 72)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Longitude",
      y = "Latitude"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}
```

```{r plot-level growth residual maps}
dist_matrix <- spDists(plot_coords, site_coords, longlat = TRUE)
nearest_site_index <- apply(dist_matrix, 1, which.min)

plot_summary$Closest_Site <- site_info_filtered$site_ids[nearest_site_index]

plot_summary <- plot_summary %>%
  left_join(
    site_info_filtered %>% dplyr::select(site_ids, pft),
    by = c("Closest_Site" = "site_ids")
  )

# Annual growth rates for observed variables
growth_table <- plot_summary %>%
  group_by(Closest_Site, INVYR) %>%
  summarise(
    WC_obs = mean(WC_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
    FC_obs = mean(FC_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
    TC_obs = mean(TC_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
    LAT = mean(LAT, na.rm = TRUE),
    LON = mean(LON, na.rm = TRUE),
    pft = first(pft),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Closest_Site, INVYR) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(INVYR) > 1) %>%
  mutate(
    year_diff = INVYR - lag(INVYR),
    obs_wc_growth = (WC_obs - lag(WC_obs)) / year_diff,
    obs_fc_growth = (FC_obs - lag(FC_obs)) / year_diff,
    obs_tc_growth = (TC_obs - lag(TC_obs)) / year_diff,
    year = paste0(lag(INVYR), "-", INVYR)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(obs_wc_growth), !is.na(obs_fc_growth), !is.na(obs_tc_growth),
    is.finite(obs_wc_growth), is.finite(obs_fc_growth), is.finite(obs_tc_growth)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    site_number = Closest_Site,
    year,
    lat = LAT,
    lon = LON,
    pft,
    obs_fc_growth,
    obs_wc_growth,
    obs_tc_growth
  )

# Trim
wc_cutoff <- quantile(abs(growth_table$obs_wc_growth), probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

growth_table <- growth_table %>%
  filter(abs(obs_wc_growth) <= wc_cutoff)

tc_cutoff <- quantile(abs(growth_table$obs_tc_growth), probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)

growth_table <- growth_table %>%
  filter(abs(obs_tc_growth) <= tc_cutoff)

load("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/samples.Rdata")

## SDA

load("/projectnb/dietzelab/dongchen/anchorSites/NA_runs/SDA_8k_site/sda.all.forecast.analysis.Rdata")

# Add site numbers to columns
vars_per_site <- c("AbvGrndWood", "LAI", "SoilMoistFrac", "TotSoilCarb")
n_sites <- 8000
site_ids <- 1:n_sites
col_names <- unlist(lapply(site_ids, function(id) paste0(vars_per_site, "_Site_", id)))

for (t in seq_along(analysis.all)) {
  colnames(analysis.all[[t]]) <- col_names
}

# Keep only AbvGrndWood and LAI
analysis.filtered <- lapply(analysis.all, function(mat) {
  if (is.null(colnames(mat))) {
    stop("analysis.all element has no column names; cannot filter by variable name.")
  }

  cols <- colnames(mat)
  keep <- grepl("^AbvGrndWood($|_)", cols) | grepl("^LAI($|_)", cols)

  if (!any(keep)) {
    stop(
      "No columns matching AbvGrndWood/LAI were found. Sample names: ",
      paste(utils::head(cols, 10), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
})

# Helper to pull site ID from variable names
extract_site <- function(x, prefix) {
  sub(paste0("^", prefix, "_Site_"), "", x)
}

# PFT lookup by site id
site_pft_lookup <- setNames(site_pft$pft, as.character(site_pft$site))

# Mod transformations
analysis.transformed <- lapply(seq_along(analysis.filtered), function(i) {
  mat <- analysis.filtered[[i]]
  cols <- colnames(mat)
  agb_cols <- grep("^AbvGrndWood_Site_", cols, value = TRUE)
  lai_cols <- grep("^LAI_Site_", cols, value = TRUE)
  agb_sites <- extract_site(agb_cols, "AbvGrndWood")
  lai_sites <- extract_site(lai_cols, "LAI")
  common_sites <- intersect(agb_sites, lai_sites)

  if (length(common_sites) == 0) return(NULL)

  out_list <- vector("list", length(common_sites) * 3)
  k <- 1

  for (site in common_sites) {
    pft_site <- site_pft_lookup[[as.character(site)]]
    if (is.null(pft_site) || is.na(pft_site)) next
    if (!(pft_site %in% names(ensemble.samples))) next

    sla_vec <- ensemble.samples[[pft_site]]$SLA

    lai_ens <- mat[, paste0("LAI_Site_", site), drop = TRUE]
    agb_ens <- mat[, paste0("AbvGrndWood_Site_", site), drop = TRUE]

    if (length(sla_vec) != length(lai_ens)) {
      stop(
        "SLA length does not match ensemble length for site ",
        site,
        " (pft = ",
        pft_site,
        ")."
      )
    }

    WC_mod <- 0.1 * agb_ens
    FC_mod <- 0.5 * lai_ens / sla_vec
    TC_mod <- WC_mod + FC_mod

    out_list[[k]] <- WC_mod
    names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("WC_mod_Site_", site)
    k <- k + 1

    out_list[[k]] <- FC_mod
    names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("FC_mod_Site_", site)
    k <- k + 1

    out_list[[k]] <- TC_mod
    names(out_list)[k] <- paste0("TC_mod_Site_", site)
    k <- k + 1
  }

  out_list <- out_list[!vapply(out_list, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (length(out_list) == 0) return(NULL)

  as.data.frame(out_list)
})

names(analysis.transformed) <- names(analysis.filtered)

# Annual change in modeled carbon ensembles
annual_change <- vector("list", length = 12)
names(annual_change) <- names(analysis.transformed)[1:12]

for (year in 1:12) {
  current_year_data <- analysis.transformed[[year]]
  next_year_data <- analysis.transformed[[year + 1]]

  year_change_data <- list()

  for (site in 1:8000) {
    fc_col_current <- paste0("FC_mod_Site_", site)
    wc_col_current <- paste0("WC_mod_Site_", site)
    tc_col_current <- paste0("TC_mod_Site_", site)

    fc_col_next <- paste0("FC_mod_Site_", site)
    wc_col_next <- paste0("WC_mod_Site_", site)
    tc_col_next <- paste0("TC_mod_Site_", site)

    if (fc_col_current %in% names(current_year_data) && fc_col_next %in% names(next_year_data) &&
        wc_col_current %in% names(current_year_data) && wc_col_next %in% names(next_year_data) &&
        tc_col_current %in% names(current_year_data) && tc_col_next %in% names(next_year_data)) {

      fc_change <- next_year_data[[fc_col_next]] - current_year_data[[fc_col_current]]
      wc_change <- next_year_data[[wc_col_next]] - current_year_data[[wc_col_current]]
      tc_change <- next_year_data[[tc_col_next]] - current_year_data[[tc_col_current]]

      year_change_data[[paste0("FoliageChange_Site", site)]] <- fc_change
      year_change_data[[paste0("WoodChange_Site", site)]] <- wc_change
      year_change_data[[paste0("TotalChange_Site", site)]] <- tc_change
    }
  }

  annual_change[[year]] <- as.data.frame(year_change_data)
}

# Mean and SD of modeled growth per site-year across ensemble members
model_growth_stats <- list()

for (year in 1:12) {
  year_data <- annual_change[[year]]

  avg_foliage_growth <- numeric(8000)
  avg_wood_growth <- numeric(8000)
  avg_total_growth <- numeric(8000)

  sd_foliage_growth <- numeric(8000)
  sd_wood_growth <- numeric(8000)
  sd_total_growth <- numeric(8000)

  for (site in 1:8000) {
    foliage_change_col <- paste0("FoliageChange_Site", site)
    wood_change_col <- paste0("WoodChange_Site", site)
    total_change_col <- paste0("TotalChange_Site", site)

    if (foliage_change_col %in% names(year_data) &&
        wood_change_col %in% names(year_data) &&
        total_change_col %in% names(year_data)) {

      avg_foliage_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[foliage_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      avg_wood_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[wood_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      avg_total_growth[site] <- mean(year_data[[total_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)

      sd_foliage_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[foliage_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_wood_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[wood_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_total_growth[site] <- sd(year_data[[total_change_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }

  model_growth_stats[[paste0("Year_", names(analysis.transformed)[year])]] <- data.frame(
    Site = 1:8000,
    AvgFoliageGrowth = avg_foliage_growth,
    AvgWoodGrowth = avg_wood_growth,
    AvgTotalGrowth = avg_total_growth,
    SDFoliageGrowth = sd_foliage_growth,
    SDWoodGrowth = sd_wood_growth,
    SDTotalGrowth = sd_total_growth
  )
}

growth_table$mod_fc <- NA
growth_table$mod_wc <- NA
growth_table$mod_tc <- NA

# Site-level average modeled growth across years, mapped onto FIA site rows
for (site in 1:8000) {
  foliage_growth_values <- numeric(12)
  wood_growth_values <- numeric(12)
  total_growth_values <- numeric(12)

  for (year_index in 1:12) {
    year_name <- paste0("Year_", names(analysis.transformed)[year_index])
    year_data <- model_growth_stats[[year_name]]

    foliage_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgFoliageGrowth[site]
    wood_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgWoodGrowth[site]
    total_growth_values[year_index] <- year_data$AvgTotalGrowth[site]
  }

  avg_foliage_growth <- mean(foliage_growth_values)
  avg_wood_growth <- mean(wood_growth_values)
  avg_total_growth <- mean(total_growth_values)

  site_row <- which(growth_table$site_number == site)

  if (length(site_row) > 0) {
    growth_table$mod_fc[site_row] <- avg_foliage_growth
    growth_table$mod_wc[site_row] <- avg_wood_growth
    growth_table$mod_tc[site_row] <- avg_total_growth
  }
}

# Residuals
growth_table$fc_residual <- growth_table$obs_fc_growth - growth_table$mod_fc
growth_table$wc_residual <- growth_table$obs_wc_growth - growth_table$mod_wc
growth_table$tc_residual <- growth_table$obs_tc_growth - growth_table$mod_tc

# Residual sign and colors
prep_residual_points <- function(data, pft_name = NULL) {
  df <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(tc_residual), !is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

  if (!is.null(pft_name)) {
    df <- df %>% filter(pft == pft_name)
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      ResidualSign = case_when(
        tc_residual > 0 ~ "Positive",
        tc_residual < 0 ~ "Negative",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Col = case_when(
        ResidualSign == "Positive" ~ "royalblue",
        ResidualSign == "Negative" ~ "orangered1",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ResidualSign), !is.na(Col))
}

plot_residual_map <- function(data, df_points, title_suffix) {
  ggplot(data = data) +
    geom_sf(fill = "lightgrey", color = "black", size = 0.01) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_points,
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = Col, size = abs(tc_residual)),
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    scale_color_identity(
      name = "Residual sign",
      breaks = c("royalblue", "orangered1"),
      labels = c("Positive", "Negative"),
      guide = "legend"
    ) +
    scale_size(range = c(0.008, 1.2), name = "Residual Size (kg C/m²/yr)") +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-160, -60), ylim = c(25, 70)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(" ", title_suffix),
      x = "Longitude",
      y = "Latitude"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    )
}

# Maps by PFT
df_con <- prep_residual_points(growth_table, "boreal.coniferous")
df_dec <- prep_residual_points(growth_table, "temperate.deciduous.HPDA")
df_all <- prep_residual_points(growth_table, NULL)

plot_residual_map(us_map, df_con, "Boreal Coniferous")
plot_residual_map(us_map, df_dec, "Temperate Deciduous")
plot_residual_map(us_map, df_all, "Combined Residuals — All PFTs")
```

```{r Combined county-level residual maps, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

    FC_Obs = sum(FC_stratum * EXPNS) / sum(EXPNS),

  ) %>%

counties <- st_read("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/shp_NLCD/cb_2024_us_county_500k.shp")

counties <- st_transform(counties, crs(NLCD1km))
TC_model <- project(TC_model, NLCD1km)

pixel_area <- prod(res(NLCD1km))

# Percent cover helper (mask is logical)
get_cover_percent <- function(mask, counties_sf, ref_rast) {
  covered_area <- exact_extract(mask, counties_sf, "sum") * pixel_area
  total_area <- exact_extract(!is.na(ref_rast), counties_sf, "count") * pixel_area
  covered_area / total_area
}

# Forest masks from NLCD codes
forest_mask_all <- (NLCD1km == 1) | (NLCD1km == 4)
forest_mask_con <- (NLCD1km == 1)
forest_mask_dec <- (NLCD1km == 4)

# Forest fraction per county 
counties$forest_frac_all <- get_cover_percent(forest_mask_all, counties, NLCD1km)
counties$forest_frac_con <- get_cover_percent(forest_mask_con, counties, NLCD1km)
counties$forest_frac_dec <- get_cover_percent(forest_mask_dec, counties, NLCD1km)

# Unweighted model mean over forest pixels
counties$mod_TC_unw <- exact_extract(TC_model, counties, "mean")

# Forest-weighted model county mean for each mask
counties$mod_TC_all <- counties$mod_TC_unw * counties$forest_frac_all
counties$mod_TC_con <- counties$mod_TC_unw * counties$forest_frac_con
counties$mod_TC_dec <- counties$mod_TC_unw * counties$forest_frac_dec

# Join FIA county obs with model

counties <- counties %>%
  mutate(

counties$COUNTYFP <- sub("^0+", "", counties$COUNTYFP)
counties$STATEFP <- sub("^0+", "", counties$STATEFP)

    ),
    TC_res = TC_Obs - mod_TC
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(

    WC_Obs, FC_Obs, TC_Obs,
    mod_TC, TC_res
  )

# County residual plotting
```
