##### *2m. County-Level Growth Residual Maps
```{r county-level growth residual maps}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(scales)

#FilteredTREECounty <- read.csv("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/FIA/FilteredTREECounty.csv.gz")

# Recode to PFT using whichever source column exists (sometimes it duplicates if you run things multiple times)
FilteredTREECounty <- (function(df) {
  cols <- names(df)
  src <- intersect(c("pft", "ClassCode", "ClassCode.x", "ClassCode.y"), cols)
  if (length(src) == 0) stop("No ClassCode/pft column found in FilteredTREECounty.")
  src <- src[1]

  df %>%
    mutate(
      pft = case_when(
        .data[[src]] %in% c("Con", 1, "1") ~ "boreal.coniferous",
        .data[[src]] %in% c("Decid", 4, "4") ~ "temperate.deciduous.HPDA",
        TRUE ~ as.character(.data[[src]])
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("ClassCode", "ClassCode.x", "ClassCode.y")))
})(FilteredTREECounty)

# County-level biomass by year and PFT 
county_biomass_pft <- FilteredTREECounty %>%
  filter(!is.na(pft)) %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, INVYR, STRATUM_CN, EXPNS, pft) %>%
  summarise(
    WC_stratum = sum(CARBON_AG * TPA_UNADJ * 0.45359237 * 0.0002471 * ADJ_FACTOR_SUBP, na.rm = TRUE),
    FC_stratum = sum(DRYBIO_FOLIAGE * 0.5 * TPA_UNADJ * 0.45359237 * 0.0002471 * ADJ_FACTOR_SUBP, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, INVYR, pft) %>%
  summarise(
    WC_Obs = sum(WC_stratum * EXPNS) / sum(EXPNS),
    FC_Obs = sum(FC_stratum * EXPNS) / sum(EXPNS),
    TC_Obs = WC_Obs + FC_Obs,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Year-to-year annualized growth at county + PFT level
county_growth_pft <- county_biomass_pft %>%
  arrange(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft, INVYR) %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft) %>%
  mutate(
    year_diff = INVYR - lag(INVYR),
    growth_wc = (WC_Obs - lag(WC_Obs)) / year_diff,
    growth_fc = (FC_Obs - lag(FC_Obs)) / year_diff,
    growth_tc = (TC_Obs - lag(TC_Obs)) / year_diff,
    year_range = paste0(lag(INVYR), "-", INVYR)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(growth_tc), is.finite(growth_tc)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Annual growth per county
county_growth_expanded_pft <- county_growth_pft %>%
  mutate(year_range = str_trim(year_range)) %>%
  tidyr::separate_wider_regex(
    year_range,
    patterns = c(start = "\\d{4}", "-", end = "\\d{4}")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start = as.integer(start),
    end = as.integer(end),
    n_intervals = pmax(end - start, 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(n_intervals > 0) %>%
  mutate(year_end_vec = map2(start, end, ~ seq(.x + 1L, .y, by = 1L))) %>%
  unnest(year_end_vec) %>%
  mutate(
    annual_growth_tc = growth_tc,
    annual_growth_wc = growth_wc,
    annual_growth_fc = growth_fc,
    year_end = year_end_vec
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft, year_end, annual_growth_tc, annual_growth_wc, annual_growth_fc)

county_annual_mean_obs_pft <- county_growth_expanded_pft %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD, pft) %>%
  summarise(
    obs_tc_annual_mean = mean(annual_growth_tc, na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_wc_annual_mean = mean(annual_growth_wc, na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_fc_annual_mean = mean(annual_growth_fc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Observed county mean annual growth across both PFTs 
county_annual_mean_obs_all <- county_growth_expanded_pft %>%
  group_by(STATECD, COUNTYCD) %>%
  summarise(
    obs_tc_annual_mean = mean(annual_growth_tc, na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_wc_annual_mean = mean(annual_growth_wc, na.rm = TRUE),
    obs_fc_annual_mean = mean(annual_growth_fc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pft = "All PFTs")

county_annual_mean_obs <- bind_rows(county_annual_mean_obs_all, county_annual_mean_obs_pft) %>%
  mutate(
    STATECD = as.character(STATECD),
    COUNTYCD = as.character(COUNTYCD)
  )

# Model county mean annual growth from TIFFs
compute_model_county_mean <- function(tif_dir, counties_sf, band = 2) {
  tif_files <- list.files(tif_dir, pattern = "^TC_\\d{4}\\.(tif|tiff)$", full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(tif_files) > 1)

  years <- as.integer(sub("^TC_(\\d{4})\\.(tif|tiff)$", "\\1", basename(tif_files)))
  ord <- order(years)
  tif_files <- tif_files[ord]
  years <- years[ord]

  r_list <- lapply(tif_files, function(f) rast(f)[[band]])
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0("TC_", years)

  r_growth <- r_stack[[2:nlyr(r_stack)]] - r_stack[[1:(nlyr(r_stack) - 1)]]
  names(r_growth) <- paste0("g_", years[-1], "_minus_", years[-length(years)])

  counties_use <- st_transform(counties_sf, crs(r_stack))
  ez <- terra::extract(r_growth, vect(counties_use), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

  mod_long <- counties_use %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(STATEFP, COUNTYFP) %>%
    mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
    inner_join(ez, by = "ID") %>%
    dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("g_"), names_to = "layer", values_to = "mod_growth") %>%
    mutate(year = as.integer(str_match(layer, "^g_(\\d{4})_minus_\\d{4}$")[, 2])) %>%
    dplyr::select(STATEFP, COUNTYFP, year, mod_growth)

  mod_county_mean <- mod_long %>%
    group_by(STATEFP, COUNTYFP) %>%
    summarise(mod_tc_annual_mean = mean(mod_growth, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      STATECD = as.character(as.integer(STATEFP)),
      COUNTYCD = as.character(as.integer(COUNTYFP))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(STATECD, COUNTYCD, mod_tc_annual_mean)

  list(mod_long = mod_long, mod_county_mean = mod_county_mean)
}

# County geometries for joins and plotting
counties <- st_read("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/shp_NLCD/cb_2024_us_county_500k.shp")

dir_con <- "/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/GEDI_SDA/averaged_tifs_con"
dir_dec <- "/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/GEDI_SDA/averaged_tifs_dec"

mod_con <- compute_model_county_mean(dir_con, counties)
mod_dec <- compute_model_county_mean(dir_dec, counties)

# Join model means onto observed
county_annual_mean_obs <- county_annual_mean_obs %>%
  left_join(
    mod_con$mod_county_mean %>% rename(mod_tc_annual_mean_con = mod_tc_annual_mean),
    by = c("STATECD", "COUNTYCD")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    mod_dec$mod_county_mean %>% rename(mod_tc_annual_mean_dec = mod_tc_annual_mean),
    by = c("STATECD", "COUNTYCD")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mod_tc_annual_mean = case_when(
      pft == "boreal.coniferous" ~ mod_tc_annual_mean_con,
      pft == "temperate.deciduous.HPDA" ~ mod_tc_annual_mean_dec,
      pft == "All PFTs" ~ rowMeans(cbind(mod_tc_annual_mean_con, mod_tc_annual_mean_dec), na.rm = TRUE),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    residual = obs_tc_annual_mean - mod_tc_annual_mean
  )

# Join residuals onto county geometries
residuals_sf <- counties %>%
  mutate(
    STATECD = as.character(as.integer(STATEFP)),
    COUNTYCD = as.character(as.integer(COUNTYFP))
  ) %>%
  left_join(county_annual_mean_obs, by = c("STATECD", "COUNTYCD")) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# County residual maps

us_map <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf")

plot_residuals_by_pft <- function(dat, pft_name, title_suffix) {
  df <- dat %>% filter(pft == pft_name, !is.na(residual))
  if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No data for PFT: ", pft_name)

  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = us_map, fill = "lightgrey", color = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = df, aes(fill = residual), color = NA) +
    geom_sf(data = us_map, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.01) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "darkred",
      mid = "white",
      high = "blue",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = range(df$residual, na.rm = TRUE),
      na.value = NA,
      name = "Residual (kg C/m²/yr)"
    ) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-160, -60), ylim = c(25, 70), expand = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = paste("County-level", title_suffix, "Growth Residuals"),
      x = "Longitude",
      y = "Latitude"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    )
}

plot_residuals_by_pft(residuals_sf, "All PFTs", "All PFTs Combined")
plot_residuals_by_pft(residuals_sf, "boreal.coniferous", "Boreal Coniferous")
plot_residuals_by_pft(residuals_sf, "temperate.deciduous.HPDA", "Temperate Deciduous")
```

##### *2n. County-Level Observed Maps
```{r county-level observed maps}

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

# County shapefile and NLCD
counties <- st_read("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/shp_NLCD/cb_2024_us_county_500k.shp")
county_obs <- read.csv("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/county_validation/FIA/county_summary_obs.csv")

# Make sure COUNTYCD and STATECD are characters for join
county_obs <- county_obs %>%
  mutate(
    COUNTYCD = as.character(COUNTYCD),
    STATECD = as.character(STATECD)
  )

counties <- counties %>%
  mutate(
    COUNTYFP = as.character(COUNTYFP),
    STATEFP = as.character(STATEFP)
  )
counties$COUNTYFP <- sub("^0+", "", counties$COUNTYFP)
counties$STATEFP <- sub("^0+", "", counties$STATEFP)


# Join observed data with county geometries and forest fractions
counties_obs <- left_join(counties, county_obs, by = c("STATEFP" = "STATECD", "COUNTYFP" = "COUNTYCD"))

# Project to WGS84 for proper plotting layout
counties_obs_plot <- st_transform(counties_obs, 4326)


# Plot!!

# Both PFTs

ggplot(data = counties_obs_plot) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = TC_Obs), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "D",
    name = "Total Biomass (kg C/m2)",
    limits = c(0,20),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(4326),
    xlim = c(-180, -50),
    ylim = c(15, 75)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, family = "Times New Roman", size = 14),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(title = "Combined")

# coniferous

  ) +
```
